title: DeepSeek: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 1017
script:
DeepSeek just released the v4.1 Flash model on OpenRouter today.
This updated version succeeds previous iterations in the DeepSeek lineup.
Developers can access the new model directly through the OpenRouter API.
It brings faster processing speeds for automated coding and text tasks.
Would you integrate this flash model into your next software project?
